title: Heading
summary: A real h1 to h6 heading in the shadow tree, with a visual size decoupled from the level: the semantic counterpart of pk-text's look-only h1 to h6 variants, for a strict module that cannot write a raw heading tag.

props.name: level
props.description: The heading level exposed to assistive technology (1 to 6, clamped and rounded; out of range falls back to 2 and warns once). Rendered as a real h1 to h6 in the shadow tree, so it takes its place in the page outline.

props.name: variant
props.description: The visual size on the --text-h1 to --text-h6 scale, independent of level: a section can be an h3 in the outline but look like an h1, or the reverse. Default inherit: the size matches level.

props.name: tone
props.description: Text colour from the theme, as on pk-text. Default inherit: the colour around it.

props.name: weight
props.description: Font weight. Default inherit: bold, the native heading weight.

props.name: truncate
props.description: Keep it to one line and end with an ellipsis when it does not fit.

slots.description: The heading text: phrasing content only.

a11y: The shadow tree renders a real h1 to h6 for the level prop, so it keeps the heading role and level in the accessibility tree and the page outline; use one h1 per page and do not skip levels. variant changes only the look: a section that must be an h3 in the outline but look larger sets level="3" variant="h1", never the reverse (a level chosen for the look breaks the outline). For a look-only heading that is not a real heading (a figure label, a number in a card), use pk-text's h1 to h6 variant instead.

examples.title: Level and look decoupled
examples.html: <pk-heading level="1">Page title</pk-heading><pk-heading level="2" variant="h4">A quiet section heading</pk-heading><pk-heading level="3" variant="h1">A section that must look bigger than its outline level</pk-heading>

examples.title: Truncated
examples.html: <pk-heading level="3" truncate>A very long record title that will not fit in a narrow card header</pk-heading>

parts.name: heading
parts.description: The rendered h1 to h6 element.

cssProperties.name: --pk-heading-size
cssProperties.description: The font size used when variant is inherit; set from level. An explicit variant overrides it.
